contracts.routing: Commit/react Symbiote family; spin one host race and finish its approved immediate/nested events under shared history; restore Symbiote caller; spin Takeover once, commit source modifiers/react, resolve awarded Symbiote Power children, then saved caller.
contracts.profileAuthority: Profiles and the Takeover wheel here are canonical. Race branch/import references point here and execute one profile once, never both mirrors as independent invocations.

thresholds.100: Total +1 each Strength/Speed/Durability/Intelligence/Fight from this Symbiote source, plus exactly two Symbiote Power spins.
thresholds.0/10: No declared numeric bonus or power spin.
thresholds.80/90: +1 Strength and +1 Durability, plus one Symbiote Power spin.

numericStats.timing: Record at committed takeover result; add once after each immutable base stat through the ledger and the signed, unbounded final-score policy.
numericStats.stacking: Execute only the selected takeover profile. The 100% source total is +1 each, not +2 Strength/Durability and not an extra third power spin. Independent other approved race/equipment modifiers retain their own rules.

powerSampling.ordering: Each actual child spin grants only its selected power and gets its own reaction before the next child. Invoke once at 80/90, twice at 100.
powerSampling.uniquenessStatus: No user-requested unique-power guarantee. Working default: separate invocations use the canonical eligible pool; do not disable a chosen section or reroll a committed duplicate. Exact repeated-definition merge/instance policy follows the pending global inventory policy.
powerSampling.idempotence: Track parent event and ordinal so replay/media retry restores committed child results rather than granting/spinning again.

contracts.ownedInventory: Preserve selected Symbiote powers after main Power None. Complete all acquisitions before the one shared mastery draw; existing shared rank is inherited by late grants. Takeover grants no mastery boost or Enchant.
contracts.classification: Symbiote is an attachment wrapper with one explicit host race spin from its FAMILY event. Takeover is scoped metadata and grants no additional host draws: 0% retains wrapper+actual host, 100% adds no unlisted personality penalty or power bundle.
contracts.inheritedOrigins: Authorized Skeleton/Zombie origin or Hybrid/host callers execute this same approved profile with actual source provenance, race-family exclusion history and saved return.
contracts.size: One global Size spin based on actual host/composite body with explicit reference policy. Any selected Raksasa activates the existing giant variant. No takeover-specific extra Size draw; unknown references never default to Human.
contracts.weights: Equal default: eleven Takeover outcomes each have base weight 1 (1/11); twelve Symbiote Power outcomes each have base weight 1 (1/12). 10% is the takeover value step, not outcome probability.
contracts.idempotence: Commit each profile once per run/source component/sourceSpinId/profile key, with each effect ordinal and child ordinal. Replay duplicates no stat modifier, power grant or spin.

host.status: User clarified Symbiote attaches to another race and Raksasa gives another race giant size; each requires one additional race spin.
host.dispatch: Every selected host/base family executes its normal approved events, including another authorized attachment/origin chain. Commit family to shared history BEFORE children.
host.identity: The wrapper component stays owned. Host/base is a linked descendant in the same Hybrid root when applicable, not a replacement result or an extra Hybrid root.
host.order: Working execution order: resolve host/base immediate events before returning to the attachment caller. Symbiote then runs its existing Takeover/power chain. Raksasa registers its existing stage effects once and returns after its base chain.
host.mastery: All early powers survive main None and use the one shared character rank; caller-scoped Authority max remains an exception. No host-specific mastery bonus inferred.
host.return: Always restore the saved nested caller; only the completed outer race event advances to Archetype.
host.exclusion: Intersect existing caller eligibility with familyId not in usedRaceFamilyIds. Disable all used sections before drawing; do not sample them then reroll.
host.termination: Each new identity-family result strictly enlarges the used set. At most the number of unique eligible catalog families can commit (17 in the current main pool), so race-family cycles cannot repeat indefinitely.
host.emptyPool: A required draw with no eligible positive-weight candidate is an explicit configuration error. Never reset history, restore used sections, silently skip, or reroll a committed result.
host.idempotence: One host/base invocation per actual wrapper source component; committed history, links, effects and child keys restore together on resume.
host.context: Record wrapper source, actual host/base and each nested descendant. Do not reveal unrolled host or final Size/Takeover results in earlier reaction.

stackedFacts: actual acquired power results in order
shared mastery status/rank only if already committed
actual host race and nested descendants, bound to source Symbiote component and Hybrid root if applicable
contextContract.futureGuard: Never name an unrolled power or base/final stat value. Narration is downstream of committed effects.
contextContract.reactionPolicy: Family, actual host race and each host event, Takeover and every power child receive one actual-spin reaction; fixed bonus/link registration creates no fake spin.

openBalance: Equal Takeover and Symbiote Power base odds are confirmed; optional later user overrides.
Set main stat scale/bounds, shared mastery scale and individual power limits/costs.
Set sourced body Size profiles and declared later odds/compatibility.
Finalize repeated power-definition merging; the two scheduled actual results and provenance are always retained.

probabilityDefaultContract.activation: Default weights do not activate or approve proposed rosters, callers or events.
